verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows the public guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent. The only hands-on probes found blocking: www.uscis.gov/llms.txt returned HTTP 403 to a standard identified UA, and the public case-status host egov.uscis.gov returned 403 with a Cloudflare challenge marker even at robots.txt. The quoted guidance-page text is content excerpts, not evidence of unchallenged agent access.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
